thread:
deploybot: Canary rollout 2.4.7 -> anomalous p95 increase (+35%) and KV cache checksum errors on gpu-pool-3. Suggest sticky fallback to 2.4.6. Auto-revert flagged OFF for Dedicated pools. See dashboard: https://telemetry.internal/r/rollouts/1749998881

alex: saw this. are dedicated customers impacted yet or only hosted?

deploybot: impact: hosted traffic 12% of canary slice, dedicated slice shows 0.8% error surface on pooling. Severity: medium. Auto-fallback path blocked by "dedicated_protect" flag.
maria: if dedicated is showing errors we should not let auto-revert run without PM/CS signoff. 

ops-oncall: agree. we should prepare a manual unwind plan in case it worsens. propose stepwise unwind: 30% -> 10% -> 0 over 10m intervals, validate p95 and kv error at each step.
sam: +1 on stepwise, also need release notes patch and customer comms draft for impacted dedicated customers. i'll start a short blurb.
tia: can someone confirm whether traffic-slice gating is per-region? we need to avoid draining EU during business hours w/o notice.
carol: EU pool is separate; this can be targeted. i'd recommend pausing canary in eu then run stepwise in us-west to get quick signal.

alex: ops-oncall, can you run the dry-run commands and post the exact rollback shorthand? ops-oncall: running now.

ops-oncall: dry-run snippet:
```
deployctl traffic set --release 2.4.7 --slice 0.30 --region us-west --reason "canary unwind - kvcache errors"
# validate -> then: deployctl traffic set --slice 0.10 ... -> deployctl traffic set --slice 0.0
```

maria: tagging support & cs: @support-team @acct-owners — we'll need to open a one-off support digest if the dedicated customers hit errors. i'll draft the email.

sam: release-notes diff: add note under "known issues" — "2.4.7: KV cache checksum observed in small fraction of requests; rollback recommended for dedicated pools until patch". i'll push to docs and link here.

deploybot: since "dedicated_protect" prevents auto-revert, human ack required. please react with :thumbsup: once you approve manual unwind.

tia: approving. :thumbsup: running first slice in 2m.

ops-oncall: executed step1 -> set slice to 30% us-west. metrics: p95 down 12% in 4m, kv errors down ~40%. continuing to step2 in 6m if stable.

alex: great. Maria, Sam — can you confirm customer comms template within 15m?
maria: template ready, sending to CS for review now.

carol: if step2 sees rebound we should escalate to rollback to 2.4.6 fully and pin for dedicated. who has authority to pin?
sam: PM signoff + eng lead ok to pin. alex, do you have bandwidth to approve pin?
alex: i can approve. pin command (manual):
```
deployctl pin --service inference --version 2.4.6 --scope dedicated --note "rollback due to kvcache checksum anomaly"
```

ops-oncall: step2 executed -> 10% -> metrics hold. proceeding to 0 in 8m.

deploybot: Note: remember to update the rollout ticket and attach metrics snapshots.

carol: after we reach 0, let's open a postmortem ticket and include token-level traces for the affected window. assigning to eng-runtime.

alex: excellent. once pinned i'll post final comms to #customers and update release notes. thanks team.

deploybot: Canary slice now 0. Confirmed 2.4.7 drained for us-west. No further automated actions for dedicated. Manual pin pending.

sam: pin done and release-notes updated. email queued to impacted accounts.

maria: CS acknowledged, template sent. closing loop here.

carol: filing follow-up: include quantization kernel check for 2.4.7. assigning to eng-ml.

alex: closing thread. good job. :rocket:
